title: Roma prepares for match against Fiorentina at the Stadio Olimpico
seoTitle: Roma prepares for Fiorentina match at Stadio Olimpico
subtitle: Italian side adjusts squad and sets lineup for Monday's match.
excerpt: Roma prepares to face Fiorentina at the Stadio Olimpico in an Italian Serie A clash.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Roma is preparing to take the pitch this Monday to face Fiorentina at the Stadio Olimpico in an Italian Serie A fixture. The clash has stirred up fans and generated high expectations surrounding the starting lineup managed by head coach Gian Piero Gasperini.

New signings and squad movements

For this season, the board made investments to strengthen the squad with a focus on the Champions League. Among the new additions are players like Nahuel Molina, Santiago Castro, Konstantinos Koulierakis, and Rodrigo Mora. On the other hand, athletes such as Zeki Çelik, Artem Dovbyk, Evan Ferguson, Stephan El Shaarawy, Lorenzo Venturino, Bryan Zaragoza, Angelino, and Kostas Tsimikas have left the club.

Players' physical condition and preparation

The coach commented on the recovery of players who returned late after participating in the World Cup, such as Ndicka, Malen, Koné, and Molina. Additionally, forward Paulo Dybala secured his stay with a one-year contract renewal and took part in the pre-season without any new injuries, arriving in excellent physical shape for the start of the matches.

Expected starting lineup

With spots still open on the UEFA Champions League registration list, the team looks to maintain competitiveness while reducing the wage bill. The probable starting lineup features Svilar in goal; Mancini, Ndicka, and Hermoso in defense; Molina, Koné, Cristante, and Wesley in midfield; along with Dybala, Rodrigo Mora, and Malen in the attacking sector.

Italian League table details

The national tournament drives the clubs in the early stages of the competition. While teams adjust their tactics and seek to secure precious points in the opening rounds, the league table determines the representatives for European competitions, such as the Champions League, Europa League, and Conference League, alongside the battle against relegation.

With information from Chiesa Di Totti, BBC.
